versions.changelog:
Initial release providing a streamlined, controllable music player skill.

- Single entry point script (`./play-music`) for all playback and control commands
- Full music control: play, pause, resume, stop, list songs, and check status
- Background server auto-starts/stops as needed for resource efficiency
- Supports custom music directories and default songs via environment variables
- Based on Pygame for cross-platform, high-quality playback
